description: Lists single time entries from mite for a period, newest first, optionally filtered by customer, project, service, user, billable or locked. Use it to find individual entries or their ids; for totals use `mite_report`, for one known entry use `mite_get_time_entry`. Each row has hours, revenue in currency units (null if none), the locked flag and the note. Returns at most `limit` entries per page (default 100, max 1000) and `has_more` when further pages exist; the period defaults to this_year.

billable.description: true = only billable, false = only non-billable, e.g. true. Default: both.

customer_id.description: Only these customers: list of customer ids, e.g. [123, 456]. Default: all customers.

from.description: Start of the period: a date as YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-01-01) or a keyword (today, yesterday, this_week, last_week, this_month, last_month, this_year, last_year). A keyword alone selects that whole period and ignores the end of it; a date alone runs up to today. Default: this_year (when from and to are both omitted).

locked.description: true = only locked, false = only unlocked, e.g. false. Default: both.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1, e.g. 2. Default: 1.

project_id.description: Only these projects: list of project ids, e.g. [789]. Default: all projects.

service_id.description: Only these services: list of service ids, e.g. [42]. Default: all services.

to.description: End of the period: a date as YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-03-31) or a keyword (today, yesterday, this_week, last_week, this_month, last_month, this_year, last_year). Default: today when only from is a date; without from the period is just this date.

user_id.description: Only these users: list of user ids, e.g. [7] (needs a key that may see other users). Default: all users the key may see.

name: mite_list_time_entries
title: List time entries
